dedupe_keys.name: macroscopic insights of iot botnet dynamics via as level tolerance assessment

description: The documented longitudinal study quantifies autonomous-system tolerance using 3.8 million malicious events across more than 8,000 autonomous systems over three years. Globally distributed honeypots, IP blacklists and regional Internet registries establish real IPv4 network observations. It is an Internet infrastructure risk-assessment application, with source data releases, precise calendar interval and deployment of a mitigation system unknown. It is distinct from the later DDoS propagation application, with event overlap not established. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
